The grade follows the model: audio rests on the shared clock, trails it through a stall, and catches up after. When a change moves a row, a steady-state lag (av_lag_ms p50) that rises, or audio the player trimmed, is a regression to fix rather than budget; a p95 lag that rises through a stall, or an underrun count that moves, is re-measured in. No ceiling is fixed at zero underruns or zero stalls; a replay row's is exactly what it measured. The replay rows are deterministic, so their ceilings are exactly what they measured, through the end of each recording, with no headroom: any regression fails them, and an improvement should be tightened in. On 2026-11-11 every player began following one stretch rule on the shared clock: it slows down below its target, speeds up above it, and skips only past its bound, which in the browser is the subscription's max delay. Every replay row was re-measured with it, the browser and native rows left to the nightly runner. Audio now rests on the clock rather than one frame ahead of it, so the A/V lag p50 rose from about -20 ms to 0.4 ms on relay-bbb, 1.1 on relay-mic, 1.2 on relay-mic-rtt40 and 1.8 on local-aac. Its p95 rose on every row, since audio that falls behind is now caught up by speeding up rather than trimmed: the shared clock steps forward as its reference converges through a tune-in backlog, and again when a target falls, and audio follows at the accelerate's pace, which on the replay's constant tone is one 2.5 ms period a window, slower than on speech. bursty-aac rests 5 ms behind its clock, so its p50 of 10.4 ms is mostly its catch-ups, and relay-mic-stall's p50 of 66.1 ms is the catch-up after its target falls from 1540 to 80 ms, which outlasts half the row. In exchange nothing is trimmed: relay-mic-stall's trimmed_ms_per_min fell from 2152.5 to 0, its skips from 6.1 to 0, and its underruns from 24.2 to 0 a minute, and player_underruns_per_min fell from 12.1 to 4 on local-aac, 16.1 to 0 on relay-bbb, 6.1 to 0 on relay-mic, 10.6 to 2.7 on relay-mic-rtt40 and 6.1 to 4 on relay-mic-stall, holding at 4.4 on bursty-aac.
